THIRD-PARTY COMPONENTS

Gleipnir links zlib, used to recover and re-emit DEFLATE streams found inside the
data being compressed.

  zlib 1.3.1
  Copyright (C) 1995-2024 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler
  https://zlib.net/

  The zlib licence is permissive and places no restriction on the terms Gleipnir
  itself is offered under, so bundling it creates no conflict. Its terms

ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS

Gleipnir's engine follows the context-mixing lineage established by Matt Mahoney's
PAQ series and ZPAQ, and the lpaq family. The techniques it builds on -- bit-
history state machines, logistic mixing in the stretched domain, SSE/APM
refinement stages, and indirect secondary symbol estimation -- originate in
that body of work. No PAQ code is used; the implementation here is independent,
but the ideas are not original to it and it would be dishonest to imply so.

Benchmarks use the Silesia corpus, assembled by Sebastian Deorowicz.
